highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.155.0 previews the Skia m155 renderer with updated image decoding and GLES interop.
highlights_body: It updates HarfBuzzSharp and disables RAW and DNG decoding. Applications needing those formats should use a dedicated decoder before creating SkiaSharp images.

bullets.detail: Aligns the bundled renderer with Skia m155 and incorporates the latest upstream m155 servicing fixes.
Updates GLES interop signatures to pass native pointers directly, improving compatibility with native OpenGL ES integration.
SkiaSharp no longer attempts to decode RAW and DNG images. Applications that accept these formats should use a dedicated decoder before creating SkiaSharp images.

preview_summaries.v4.155.0-preview.1.26471.14: Preview 1 opened the 4.155 line with the Skia m155 engine update.
preview_summaries.v4.155.0-preview.2.26479.13: Preview 2 added m155 servicing fixes, pointer-based GLES interop, and the HarfBuzzSharp update.

harfbuzz_summary: Updates the bundled HarfBuzzSharp native library to version 14.4.0.

v4.155.0-preview.1.26471.14.headline: SkiaSharp 4.155.0 Preview 1 introduces the Skia m155 engine update.

v4.155.0-preview.2.26479.13.headline: SkiaSharp 4.155.0 Preview 2 refreshes the renderer and HarfBuzzSharp.
v4.155.0-preview.2.26479.13.body: It also updates GLES interop and disables RAW and DNG image decoding.
